Country.evidence_source: Based on the knowledge that few studies have identified compassion and psychological flexibility as relevant mechanisms related to positive body image, the aim of the present study is, firstly, to further explore the body appreciation phenomenon among Portuguese women, and how self-compassionate engagement and action may differentially impact on body appreciation.

section_summary.extract_value: This introduction reviews literature on negative and positive body image and highlights body appreciation as a key positive body image construct. The authors state the aim of the present study is to explore body appreciation among Portuguese women and test whether self-compassionate engagement and action (and psychological flexibility) relate to higher body appreciation, predicting that action will have a stronger impact and that engagement associates with action via lower psychological inflexibility.
